text: Hang on there a minute, Moonpie.
I want to teach you something.
Look at your cards, and then look at the mirror.
And what does that tell me about your cards?
Attaboy. Now, look at my face.
It's a good thing I love you.
I'm gonna look at my cards again.
So, I'm gonna see you, nickel.
No, I have good cards. You have bad cards.
I made you think I was unhappy.
But that's lying. You lied to your Moon Pie.
Sheldon, what's on a person's face is not always what's in their heart.
Well, this changes everything. How do you know who to trust?
Meemaw liked to teach me things that kept me awake at night.
I sent Georgie on a beer run
Was I supposed to stiff him?
